front.title: Schema Interfaces for Network Management Agent Skills

abstract.t:
Network management agents can use an Agent-to-Agent protocol for task exchange. The protocol alone does not define the application schemas used by independently developed network management agent skills.
This document standardizes four components for schema-governed network management agent skills: Schema References, per-skill Skill Interface Documents, advertisement and retrieval through an A2A extension and describe_skill, and the A2A mapping for interface version 1.0. Together, they enable clients to retrieve and validate the application schemas used for skill inputs, outputs, and supporting records.
